body:
STOP: the amended immutable-oracle contract is clear, but the existing confinement helper cannot express its fixed second read-only mount plus oracle cwd unmodified. Exact API: session.rs::bwrap_confinement_args_inner(worktree: &Path, rw_paths: &[PathBuf], read_allowlist: &[String]). Every allow-list entry emits `--ro-bind-try

` (source and destination identical). The helper then always adds `--bind ` and `--chdir `. Its convenience wrapper supplies an empty read allow-list. There is no read-only source/destination mapping for ` -> /oracle`, nor a separate oracle-cwd parameter. Supplying the oracle as worktree makes it writable; staging under /tmp also loses an earlier allow-list bind to the helper's later --tmpfs /tmp. I have not changed session.rs, appended custom mounts, or built a second sandbox. Draft PR #2660 preserves the tested prototype, explicitly not ready; TASK-1730 remains NeedsAttention. The new oracle_paths/oracle_sha/bundle-hash contract is not yet implemented because the amended ruling explicitly says STOP on this capability gap. Advisor options: assign/authorize an existing-helper API extension in a containment lane, or explicitly approve the narrower existing capability: freeze the bundle outside /tmp, bind it read-only at its identical canonical host path through read_allowlist, and use an ordinary executable cwd wrapper to run the oracle there while the trial remains the helper's writable worktree. That alternative preserves immutability but changes the ruling's fixed namespace-root semantics; I will not infer that exception. TASK-1729 rework verification continues independently.
subject: regen lane: #2660 stopped at fixed read-only oracle mount gap
